free_block_z.basis_rule: brandt_symn_int_canonical/v2: Lambda = Z[T_p : p in ops] . Z^d (the Hecke-stable hull: the smallest Hecke-stable lattice containing Z^d), Z^d = the Q-coordinates of symn.SymBrandt's rational model (+)_c V_Q^{Gamma_c} (V_Q = V^phi, Q-basis and Gamma_c-invariant bases as in symn.py) with the class blocks in the k = 2 canonical order (classes sorted ascending by (|Gamma_c|, (r_c(1),...,r_c(20))), r_c(m) = #{x in O_r(I_c) : nrd x = m} (x, -x both counted); ties listed in order_ties, order within a tie unspecified); basis = the columns of the lower-triangular HNF of Lambda; depends on the ops list and on symn.py's class representatives (canonical: false)
free_block_z.convention: column: T_p b_j = sum_i F[i][j] b_i; b_j = the j-th column of basis_in_Q_coords (a basis of the Hecke-stable hull Lambda); no row-sum identity (no Eisenstein system at k > 2)
